The new coach is now being tested by the “Children of the Bank.” It didn’t take long for the head “child” to put himself above his teammates, above the franchise, and above the city that feeds him.

John Harbaugh was old school. He preached fundamentals and toughness, and even on his watch the organization let players get bigger than the team.

That loss felt like a collective trauma, and we’ve watched the culture of the organization shift since then. Players have been positioning themselves as bigger than the team. We can easily name them. The bigger problem is that the organization has done nothing but cater to them.

The Ravens need to send a message to one player. What they do about that one player will speak to the soul of this team and what it will be for the foreseeable future.

In a way, this moment has been building since the loss to Buffalo in the snow.
